en: Shuichi! Teach Gonta how to be gentleman!

I-I told you, I wouldn't know
anything about that...

<CLT=cltMIND>This interrogation has been going
on for some time now.

<CLT=cltMIND>It appears that Gonta mistakenly believes
I have a lot of knowledge of "gentlemen."

<CLT=cltMIND>It took a while, but I think I
finally made Gonta understand...
Oh... Even Shuichi no can teach Gonta...
Y-Yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel awful...
I can't let him stay down like this.

Hey, Gonta?
Why are you so focused on being a gentleman?
...For forest family.

Time in forest make Gonta forget 
human ways.

People start worry about Gonta.
Say Gonta not know how to socialize.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's understandable...
You were raised in the wild, after all.

Gonta rejoin human family but...Gonta
not really feel accepted.

Human family treat Gonta like their own,
but...
They not accept forest family.

Didn't accept them?
What do you mean?
Gonta not know whole story...

All Gonta know is, Gonta's human family
very famous, very respected.

Really!?
Is that so...?

So they get mad at Gonta. Say Gonta not
worthy of family name.

They blame Gonta's forest family.
Say it all their fault.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's awful...they should have been
grateful for taking care of you for a decade...

Gonta love forest family.
Forest family very important to Gonta.

And Gonta love human family, too.
Gonta love human mother who birth him.

So Gonta want human family to accept
forest family...

So Gonta think, become true gentleman!
Then human family accept forest family!

And...forest family also be proud of Gonta!
See Gonta become such great gentleman!
That sounds like a great idea!
Ah...you think so...?
Perhaps a different way would be better?
Are you unsure of something?

Gonta not smart, but he think about this a lot!
Is good idea, right Shuichi?
That sounds like a great idea!

Thanks! Gonta feel more confident if
Shuichi approve!

Gonta gonna work hard to become true
gentleman!
Ah...you think so...?
Huh? Is bad idea?

No, it's not "bad"... It's just that becoming
a gentleman takes quite some time...

Gonta not care how long it take!
Gonta serious...

No matter how long it take, no matter how
hard, Gonta gonna become gentleman!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta might never be able to become a
gentleman, but I'd never tell him that...
Perhaps a different way would be better?

Different way? Umm...
What kinda different way?

Ah, well, um...
Perhaps a respectable career?

Even with respectable career...
Gonta still must be respectable person.

<CLT=cltMIND>...That's true.
Perhaps that's what his family wanted.
Yes, exactly right.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...even if Gonta does become a
gentleman, his forest family would still...

<CLT=cltMIND>No, I shouldn't put doubts in his head.
He wants to do this so bad.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Gonta's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I parted ways,
and I returned to my room.
